bull_case: AI data-center power demand, liquid cooling, service penetration and behind-the-meter generation let Vertiv roughly double economic value over five years and sustain high-value growth through the next decade.
bear_case: The current backlog represents front-loaded hyperscaler investment; after 3-5 years, capacity catches up, pricing normalizes and acquisitions become the main growth source.
thesis: A five-year doubling is credible without assuming extreme share gain: 2026 organic growth is guided above 30%, power density is rising, and liquid cooling/service/microgrid add content per project. The 5-10 year runway is plausible, but the market already prices near the locked Base DCF, so the evidence for a material market misperception is only moderate.

evidence.claim: 2026 organic sales growth guidance is 30%-32% from a 2025 base of $10.23B.
Backlog reached $15.0B at 2025 year-end, more than doubling YoY.
PurgeRite and UIG extend the addressable stack into liquid cooling and microgrid/behind-the-meter power.
Locked price/Base value is about 1.04x, indicating the market already discounts a strong long-term trajectory.

counterevidence: Several growth vectors share the same hyperscaler/AI capex driver rather than being fully independent.
Five-year doubling from a near-$14B 2026 run-rate would require substantial sustained infrastructure spending.
UIG growth is acquisition-dependent and not yet proven under Vertiv ownership.
Current valuation already reflects a meaningful portion of the structural thesis.
unknowns: Recurring service growth relative to equipment.
falsifiers: If organic growth drops below 10% by 2027-28 without service/liquid-cooling offset, the five-year doubling case weakens.
If high-density content per rack and service attach keep rising, growth duration extends.
A large valuation reset with unchanged fundamentals would improve market-misperception score.

subscores.rationale: A roughly 2x five-year expansion is credible from high-density power/cooling demand and adjacent services without requiring 3x+ heroic scale.
A 5-10 year runway is plausible from power-density, cooling and service vectors, but >10-year high growth is not yet evidenced.
Management has rapidly reallocated capacity and portfolio toward liquid cooling, AI power and service while preserving execution.
There is a reasonable case that duration/content per rack is underestimated, but price near locked Base means a clear reverse-DCF expectation gap is not demonstrated.

uncertainties.rationale: The current base is already large after exceptional 2026 growth.
AI infrastructure cycle duration is the central long-horizon uncertainty.
Acquisition integration and downturn response remain untested.
Current valuation already embeds substantial structural growth.
